# Kingbowen (Heshan City Jinbowen Industrial Technology Co., Ltd.)

> Whiteboard manufacturer for wholesale distributors, corporate procurement, and educational institutions in the EU and US markets.

## Company

- Legal name: Heshan City Jinbowen Industrial Technology Co., Ltd.
- Brand: Kingbowen
- Founded: 2003
- Production base: 19,000+ m² in Heshan City, Jiangmen, Guangdong Province, China
- Export experience: 50+ markets
- Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, BSCI social compliance audit, REACH & RoHS compliant materials
- OEM/ODM: bespoke dimensions, custom aluminum frame profiles, anodized finishes, laser logo engraving, silk-screen grid/planner printing, ISTA-3A drop-tested retail packaging

## Product lines (official factory models)

- Whiteboard Easel: BW-E6, BW-E3
- Flip Chart Stand: BW-E7, BW-E10, BW-E17
- Magnetic Writing Board: BW-V8, BW-V1, BW-V2
- Notice Board: BW-V1 (Notice), BW-V2 (Notice)
- Showcase: BW-A1, BW-B1, BW-C3
- Magnetic Glass Writing Board: BW-V16, BW-DT
- Iron Desktop Writing Board: BW-D1

## Commercial terms

- Minimum order quantity (MOQ): trial orders from 50 to 100 units
- Lead time: 15 to 25 days (model dependent)
- Trade terms: FOB Shenzhen/Guangzhou, CIF, DDP
